blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Arcy James Gonzales, branch manager of Asia United Bank (AUB)–Davao Toril Branch, takes the witness stand for the prosecution on Day 35 of Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial. He is expected to identify the bank accounts and transaction records of Duterte and her husband, Manases “Mans” Carpio, maintained with AUB./dp READ:
